parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The name of the gateway device.

>  If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the **ProductKey** parameter.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the gateway device. The ID is the unique identifier that is issued by IoT Platform to the gateway device.

>  If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify the **ProductKey** or **DeviceName** parameter. The **IotId** parameter specifies a unique identifier for the device, and corresponds to a combination of the **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** parameters. If you specify the **IotId** parameter and a combination of the **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** parameters at the same time, the **IotId** parameter takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Internet of Things (IoT) service instance. This parameter is not required for public instances. However, this parameter is required for enterprise-edition instances.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the gateway device belongs.

>  If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the **DeviceName** parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot get-thing-topo --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --page-size 10 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name light --page-no 1 --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot GetThingTopo --region cn-hangzhou --IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --PageSize 10 --PageNo 1 --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName light
